title: eDNA Extraction Protocol from Sterivex Filters Using Qiagen DNeasy Kit
author: Igor A. Nascimento
materials: Assemble materials and reagents: - 1000 µL pipette tips (that fit the inlet of the Sterivex) - 200 µL pipette tips - Proteinase K (Qiagen DNeasy Blood �26 Tissue Kit) - Buffer ATL (Qiagen DNeasy Blood �26 Tissue Kit)
Shake by hand for several seconds to mix the reagents.
Open and label additional materials from the Qiagen DNeasy Blood �26 Tissue Kit: - DNeasy Mini spin columns: (# samples + extraction blank) - Collection tubes: (# samples + extraction blank) × 2
Assemble additional reagents and materials: - Sterile 3 mL syringes (one per sample) - Buffer AL - Buffer AW1 - Buffer AW2
Discard the flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Decontaminate bench and chairs
steps.instruction: Clean the bench area and chairs with 5 % bleach, rinse with water, disinfect with 70 % ethanol, then apply RNase Away to all equipment that will be used.

steps.title: Set incubator temperature
steps.instruction: Turn on the incubator and set it to 56 °C.

steps.title: Sterilize pipettes (initial)
steps.instruction: Wipe down the 1000 µL and 200 µL pipettes with RNase Away and expose each side to UV light for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Retrieve Sterivex filters
steps.instruction: Remove Sterivex filters from the –15 °C freezer, take each filter out of its Whirl‑Pak bag and remove both caps from the cartridge.

steps.title: Remove storage buffer
steps.instruction: Using a dedicated sterile 3 mL syringe for each filter, attach it to the inlet, introduce air, and gently push to expel all storage buffer from the Sterivex cartridge.

steps.title: Seal cartridge inlet
steps.instruction: After discarding the liquid, close the inlet end of the Sterivex cartridge with a luer cap.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette 720 µL Buffer ATL onto the filter through the inlet (avoid backflow), then add 80 µL Proteinase K directly onto the filter, and secure the cartridge with the luer cap.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Place all filters on the roller shaker inside the incubator and incubate at 56 °C for ~16 hours (minimum 4 hours) while rotating at approximately 400 rpm.

steps.title: Post‑incubation decontamination
steps.instruction: Clean the bench area and chairs again with 5 % bleach, rinse, disinfect with 70 % ethanol, and apply RNase Away to all equipment.

steps.title: Sterilize tube racks
steps.instruction: Soak all tube racks in 10 % bleach solution, rinse three times with DI water, allow racks to dry, then expose to UV light for 15 minutes.

steps.title: UV‑sterilize LoBind tubes
steps.instruction: UV‑sterilize LoBind tubes for 15 minutes in pre‑sterilized racks and label: for each sample plus extraction blank prepare three 1.5/2 mL tubes and one 5 mL tube; also prepare additional tubes for pre‑warmed Buffer AE.

steps.title: Sterilize additional pipettes
steps.instruction: Wipe down the 1000 µL, 200 µL, 100 µL, and 10 µL pipettes with RNase Away and expose each side to UV light for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare ethanol and Buffer AE
steps.instruction: Place a 50 mL tube of molecular‑grade ethanol in a –20 °C freezer or on ice; heat an aliquot of Buffer AE (Qiagen DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit) in a heating block at 70 °C, preparing volume = (n × 100 µL) + 15 µL where n = number of samples + extraction blanks.

steps.title: Label DNA storage tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare cryo‑labels for DNA storage tubes (two of the three 1.5/2 mL LoBind tubes previously sterilized).

steps.title: Recover lysate from filters
steps.instruction: Remove Sterivex filters from the incubator, shake vigorously for several seconds, remove both caps, attach a sterile 3 mL syringe to the inlet, withdraw ~700 µL lysate, record the recovered volume, and transfer it to a sterile 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Prepare extraction blank
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL ultrapure water to a sterile 2 mL tube to serve as an extraction blank (optional).

steps.title: Add AL buffer and ethanol
steps.instruction: For each sample and extraction blank, add Buffer AL and pre‑chilled 100 % ethanol to the recovered lysate in a 1:1:1 ratio (lysate : AL : ethanol).

steps.title: Homogenize mixture
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture for 10 seconds to homogenize.

steps.title: Load onto spin columns
steps.instruction: Pipette up to 650 µL of the mixture into a DNeasy Mini Spin column placed in a collection tube, centrifuge 1 minute at 6000 × g (~8000 rpm), discard the flow‑through, and return the spin column to the same collection tube; repeat the pipette‑centrifuge‑discard cycle until the entire sample has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW1, centrifuge 1 minute at 6000 × g (~8000 rpm), discard the flow‑through, and return the column to the same tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2 and dry
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2, centrifuge 3 minutes at 20 000 × g (~14 000 rpm) to dry the membrane, discard the flow‑through, return the column to the same tube, then centrifuge again 1 minute at 20 000 × g (~14 000 rpm) to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: First DNA elution
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new sterile 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube labeled with the sample ID, add 50 µL Buffer AE onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature (20–25 °C) for 1 minute, centrifuge 1 minute at 8000 rpm, and retain the eluate.

steps.title: Second DNA elution
steps.instruction: Add an additional 50 µL Buffer AE directly onto the membrane and centrifuge 1 minute at 8000 rpm; retain this eluate as well.

steps.title: Store DNA extracts
steps.instruction: Store the combined eluate (≈100 µL per sample) at –20 °C.
